description: A term whose symbol support is contained in \(S\) restricts to a term of the sublanguage determined by \(S\), with the same variable context.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ChangingLanguages.restrictTerm.{u, v, w} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {α : Type w}
  (S : Finset L.Symbols) (t : L.Term α) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ChangingLanguages.termSymbols t ⊆ S →
    (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ChangingLanguages.supportedLanguage S).Term α
